changelog: **A private "your impact" card on the mentor dashboard** (light gamification). `/mentor` now shows the signed-in mentor — and only them — four true counts: people mentored (distinct people across every relation, any status), currently active, how many reached an internship stage or beyond, and how many reached the tenant's own finished stage. The rule is dependency-free in `src/lib/mentorImpactRule.ts` (unit-tested in `scripts/test/mentor-impact.test.mjs`, coverage floor 95): outcome membership comes from `outcomeStageKeysFrom()` over the tenant's resolved stages (#1882, never a hardcoded `HIRED_660`), the internship phase from `PIPELINE_GROUPS` (null — the row is hidden — when a renamed pipeline has no internship stage), and "reached" means ever reached, read from both ends of each real stage move (`REAL_STAGE_MOVE`), so a mentee who was hired and then moved on still counts. A handover is not a visit (docs/mentor-transfer.md, #2289): a relation that continues a predecessor (`previousRelationId`) credits its mentor only with stages entered by real moves on it, never the stage `transferMentorship` carried over, so an outcome reached under the previous mentor stays on that mentor's card alone. The query (`src/lib/mentorImpact.ts`) reads only `mentorId = caller` inside `tenantWhere(session)` and returns null without the `mentorship` capability; with zero relations the card is not rendered. No points, badges, streaks, ranking or comparison with other mentors, and nothing counts logged activity (the billing meter does, docs/metering.md). Strings in a new `mentorImpact` namespace, argued into `LEAK_EXEMPT` (mentor shell only); feature catalogue entry `mentorImpact` (capability `mentorship`).

en: Mentors now see a private summary of their own impact on the dashboard: how many people they have guided, how many they guide now, and how many reached an internship or a hire. Only you see it — no points, no rankings, no comparisons.
tr: Mentorlar artık panolarında kendi katkılarının özel bir özetini görüyor: kaç kişiye yol gösterdikleri, şu an kaç kişiyle çalıştıkları ve kaç kişinin staja ya da işe ulaştığı. Bunu yalnızca sen görürsün — puan yok, sıralama yok, karşılaştırma yok.
de: Mentoren sehen auf ihrem Dashboard jetzt eine private Übersicht ihrer eigenen Wirkung: wie viele Personen sie begleitet haben, wie viele sie gerade begleiten und wie viele ein Praktikum oder eine Einstellung erreicht haben. Nur du siehst sie — keine Punkte, kein Ranking, keine Vergleiche.
